name: Processing statuses and outputs
summary: The statuses a job moves through, the realities (point clouds, orthophotos, image sets) processing creates, the checks before a reality is made active, and the signals that tell downstream steps a snapshot is ready.

roles.note: Outputs are written by the pipeline and activated by Track3D operations. Customers only see the result. Which project permission guards reality activation in the web app wasn't traced here.

requirements.title: Jobs carry a pipeline status, a processing outcome and error tags
requirements.statement: A job has a pipeline status (from captured and uploaded through readyForStitching, readyForProcessing, processingFailed, geoSpatialMapping and realityUploaded to active) and a separate processing outcome: processing, partiallyProcessedOngoing, partialProcessed, active or error. A partly processed job can record the percentage processed. Error tags such as "Improper lighting" or "Firmware issues" are kept only while the outcome is error or partialProcessed, and are cleared otherwise.

requirements.title: Reaching geoSpatialMapping creates the job's reality
requirements.statement: When the pipeline sets a job to geoSpatialMapping, the platform creates a reality for the job's capture with status created and prepares its storage folder. 360 video, phone image, 360 image, laser and phone video captures get a point cloud; drone captures get a point cloud and an orthophoto. The job then moves to realityUploaded. (Current behaviour) On the staging site it moves to readyForProcessing instead.

requirements.title: A reality is made active only when its required output files exist
requirements.statement: Activating a reality through the platform first checks that the files required for its mode exist in storage, for example the image list (and the images folder, except for phone images), plus point-cloud files for 360 video and drone. If any is missing it refuses, and the reality keeps its status. A 360 video reality also needs its job's processing outcome set. Laser and phone video list only an empty entry, which the code-first docs read as no check. Activation then refreshes the snapshot, zone coverage, capture counts and turnaround tracking.

requirements.title: A snapshot is ready for merging once all its jobs have finished and one succeeded
requirements.statement: A capture-api worker signals once per snapshot when the snapshot is Active, every job in it has a final outcome (active, partialProcessed or error) and at least one is active or partialProcessed. It also raises the project's latest snapshot date. Ready means finished, not that every job succeeded. The once-only claim is taken before delivery and isn't released if delivery fails. (Current behaviour) Antman's db-merger endpoint only logs what it receives.

requirements.title: (Current behaviour) The reality hierarchy callback is rejected for a missing pipeline version
requirements.statement: It requires jobId, the hierarchy and a pipeline version. Antman sends this callback only for v9 processing runs, without the pipeline version, so capture-api rejects it and Antman only logs the failure.
